source: OpenTable Ann Arbor date-night/ambience/wine-bar lists (Nov 2026 reviews), venue official sites, U-M visitor pages; coordinates from US Census geocoder (Nominatim blocked)

spots.name: University of Michigan Museum of Art (UMMA)
spots.blurb: Major university art museum with free admission; open late Thursday through Sunday.
spots.blurbEs: Gran museo de arte universitario con entrada gratis; abre hasta tarde de jueves a domingo.

spots.name: U-M Museum of Natural History
spots.blurb: Dinosaur skeletons and science exhibits in the Biological Sciences Building, free for families; open Tuesday–Sunday.
spots.blurbEs: Esqueletos de dinosaurios y exhibiciones de ciencia en el Biological Sciences Building, gratis para familias; abre de martes a domingo.

spots.name: Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum
spots.blurb: Interactive science museum for kids, open 10 a.m.–5 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday.
spots.blurbEs: Museo de ciencias interactivo para niños, abierto de 10 a.m. a 5 p.m. de martes a domingo.

spots.name: Ann Arbor Farmers Market
spots.blurb: Year-round city market next to Kerrytown's shops and Zingerman's; Saturdays 7 a.m.–3 p.m. through December.
spots.blurbEs: Mercado municipal abierto todo el año junto a las tiendas de Kerrytown y Zingerman's; los sábados de 7 a.m. a 3 p.m. hasta diciembre.

spots.name: Nichols Arboretum
spots.blurb: Rolling trails along the Huron River, open sunrise to sunset; good for a crisp weekend walk.
spots.blurbEs: Senderos entre colinas junto al río Huron, abiertos del amanecer al atardecer; ideales para una caminata de fin de semana.

spots.name: Matthaei Botanical Gardens
spots.blurb: Indoor conservatory and gardens, a warm escape on a cold day; open Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
spots.blurbEs: Invernadero y jardines, un refugio cálido en un día frío; abre de martes a sábado, de 10 a.m. a 4:30 p.m.
